subject: Order confirmation — M'Arte
preview: Your order has been received — thank you for your trust.
heading: Thank you for your order
message: We are delighted to confirm your order. Every M'Arte piece is crafted by hand — our workshop will begin preparations shortly.
messageSecondary: Below is a summary of your purchase.
accountCtaNote: Create an account to track your order status and view your purchase history.
createAccountCta: Create account and track your order

fulfillmentTime.note: Counted from the acceptance of the order. When an order includes several products, the longest of their fulfillment times applies, and the order ships in one parcel.

estimatedDelivery.courier: Up to 4 business days after dispatch
estimatedDelivery.locker: Up to 4 business days after dispatch
estimatedDelivery.in_store: Ready for collection at the atelier by the end of the fulfillment time; we will let you know

closingNote: We will email you again as soon as your order has been shipped. If you have any questions about your order, simply reply to this email — we are happy to help.

contract.label: Your contract
contract.body: This email confirms the sales contract concluded with the seller named below when your paid order was accepted, on the Terms of Service you accepted at checkout. Please keep it as your record of the contract.

withdrawal.label: Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.period: As a consumer, you may withdraw from this contract within 14 days without giving any reason. The period runs from the day you, or a person you name other than the carrier, take possession of the products. Sending your statement before the period ends is enough to meet the deadline.
withdrawal.how: To withdraw, use the withdrawal form on our website, linked below, or send us a clear statement by e-mail to {email} or by post to the seller's address below. You may use the model withdrawal form attached to this email, which is in Polish, but you do not have to.
withdrawal.returnShipping: Send the products back to that address no later than 14 days after withdrawing; posting them before then is enough. You bear the direct cost of returning them.
withdrawal.refund: We refund all payments received from you, including the cost of the cheapest standard delivery we offer, no later than 14 days after receiving your statement, using the same means of payment you used for the order. We may withhold the refund until we have the products back or you have supplied proof of sending them, whichever comes first.
withdrawal.exception: The right of withdrawal does not cover products made to your own specifications, such as a size outside our range or an engraving agreed with us individually. The sizes and finishes offered as variants in the shop are covered.

complaints.label: Complaints
complaints.liability: We are liable for any lack of conformity of the products with the contract that becomes apparent within 2 years of delivery. You may ask for a repair or a replacement and, in the cases the law sets out, reduce the price or withdraw from the contract.
complaints.how: Send a complaint by e-mail to {email} or by post to the seller's address below, with your order number and a description of the problem. We pay to send the product to us and back. We reply within 14 days of receiving the complaint, and a complaint we leave unanswered by then is deemed accepted.
complaints.outOfCourt: You may also use out-of-court means of handling complaints and pursuing claims, which is voluntary and requires the consent of both parties: ask the district or municipal consumer ombudsman (powiatowy or miejski rzecznik konsumentów) at the district or city office for free assistance, apply to the Voivodeship Inspectorate of Trade Inspection (Wojewódzki Inspektorat Inspekcji Handlowej) for out-of-court resolution of the dispute, or ask a consumer organization such as the Federacja Konsumentów or the Stowarzyszenie Konsumentów Polskich for help. Their contact details and the register of bodies authorized to resolve consumer disputes out of court are on the website of the Polish Office of Competition and Consumer Protection: uokik.gov.pl.
